methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search beard-trimmer and hair-clipper models (budget, mid-range, professional) as of mid-2026. Independently re-verified against official brand pages (usa.philips.com, shop.panasonic.com, andis.com, us.braun.com, wahlusa.com, brio4life.com), retail listings (Amazon, Walmart, thisisbeauty.us), and editorial reviews (GroomReviews, ShavingAdvisor, ToolsAndToys). priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or current street price at a primary retailer; cordless is true when the unit operates without a cord; runtime_min is cordless battery runtime at standard settings; null where a spec could not be confirmed from a primary source. accessedAt 2026-06-19. Two numeric corrections made vs draft: Braun AIO7440 list price 119.94->119.99 and Remington PG6025 runtime 70->65. All 11 products verified to exist; none removed.

products.name: Philips Norelco Multigroom 7000 MG7750/49
products.priceNote: Last published Walmart price; Philips direct page marks product no longer available
products.provenance: Verified: 23-piece kit (Amazon/Philips title), DualCut self-sharpening stainless-steel blades, 5-hour (300-min) cordless runtime, 14 reinforced guards, max 16 mm. Price $59.99 per Walmart; Philips US direct page shows product discontinued.

products.name: Philips Norelco Multigroom 3000 MG3750/60
products.priceNote: Philips official MSRP; product marked discontinued on Philips US site
products.provenance: Verified: $19.95 MSRP, 13 attachments, 7 length settings, 60-min runtime, DualCut self-sharpening steel blades, max 16 mm. blade_material corrected from draft's 'tempered steel' to 'steel (DualCut, self-sharpening)' per Philips spec language. First availability ~late 2016.

products.name: Braun All-in-One Series 7 AIO7440
products.priceNote: List/MSRP price; widely discounted to ~$66-95 at major retailers
products.provenance: Braun US official page verified 40 length settings (0.5-20 mm), 100-min cordless runtime, full-metal ProBlade (lifetime ultra sharp), 12-in-1 kit. priceUsd corrected 119.94->119.99 to match actual list price (thisisbeauty.us shows list $119.99, sale $94.95); draft's $119.94 was a fabricated precision. Released November 2022.

products.name: Wahl Stainless Steel Lithium Ion+ 9818A
products.priceNote: Street price (~$60 across review sites); Amazon sale recorded ~$55.58
products.provenance: Verified via ToolsAndToys and The Beard Review: T-blade + rotary detail head + 8 T-blade guide combs + 10-position adjustable comb (16 total accessories), stainless-steel self-sharpening blades, 4-hour (240-min) runtime, adjustable comb to 11 mm. Price ~$59.99 (Amazon ~$55.58 on sale). Original release year not verifiable; releaseDate null.

products.name: Panasonic ER-GB80-S
products.priceNote: Sale price at Panasonic official US shop; regular price $89.99
products.provenance: Panasonic official shop verified $74.99 sale (reg $89.99), 39 length settings (0.5-20 mm), 50-min cordless runtime, hypoallergenic 45-degree stainless-steel blades, corded/cordless operation. 3 comb attachments (A 1-10mm, B 11-20mm, 1.5mm body) per Amazon/Walmart. First available 2015.

products.name: Manscaped The Beard Hedger
products.priceNote: Amazon/Manscaped MSRP for standalone trimmer (Walmart lists $99.97)
products.provenance: Launch confirmed January 17, 2023 via BusinessWire. Verified 20 length settings (0.5 mm increments to 10 mm), 41 mm titanium-coated stainless-steel T-blade, 7,200 RPM motor, 60-min runtime, waterproof. Price ~$99.99 ($99.97 Walmart). attachments_count 1 (included beard comb only).

products.name: Andis Master Cordless Li Clipper 12660
products.priceNote: MSRP per Andis official product page
products.provenance: Andis official page verified $229.99, 6500 SPM high-speed rotary motor, 90-min runtime (1-hr charge), carbon-steel blade adjustable #000 to #1, cord/cordless. Accessories: charger stand, adapter, blade guard, blade oil (4). length_settings and max_length_mm null: single adjustable blade, not numbered guide combs. (Note: some retail listings cite 7,200 SPM but the official Andis spec is 6500 SPM.)

products.name: Wahl Elite Pro 79602
products.priceNote: MSRP per Wahl USA official site (wahlusa.com)
products.provenance: Wahl USA official site verified $59.99 MSRP. 10 guide combs (No. 1/2 to No. 8, 1.5-25 mm), self-sharpening precision blades, corded-only, 21-piece kit. Max length 25 mm (#8 = 1 inch). runtime_min null: corded-only clipper.

products.name: Remington PG6025 All-in-One Grooming Kit
products.priceNote: Approximate current Amazon street price (under $20); original MSRP not published by Remington
products.provenance: Verified: 8-piece kit (trimmer, foil shaver, nose/ear/detail trimmer, hair-clipper comb, 3 beard/stubble combs, pouch), 8 hair-comb settings (2-16 mm), surgical-steel self-sharpening blades. runtime_min corrected 70->65: Remington official spec is up to 65 min lithium runtime, not 70. First available Jan 2014; street price under $20.

products.name: Philips Norelco OneBlade Pro QP6550/70
products.priceNote: Philips US suggested retail price; also listed at $79.96 on Walmart
products.provenance: Philips US official page verified $79.96, 14 lock-in length settings (0.4-10 mm), 120-min runtime from 1-hr charge, proprietary OneBlade cutter. Accessories: 14-length comb, pouch, charging stand (3). Walmart corroborates price/settings.

products.name: Brio Beardscape V2
products.priceNote: Direct price from brio4life.com official store
products.provenance: Brio official store verified $129.95, ceramic blade (4x harder than steel), USB-C, 4-hour (240-min) runtime, 5 speeds. ShavingAdvisor confirmed 9 reversible guards yielding 25 possible length settings, max 20 mm. First available ~May 2022. attachments_count 7 (combs/stand/brush/lubricant).
